extracted.name: Buttercream icing
extracted.description: Foolproof cake frosting requires just butter and icing sugar – try out different flavourings and use our guide for quantities
instruction_lines: Beat 600g sifted icing sugar and 300g butter together with your chosen flavouring and colouring if using, add 2-3 tbsp of boiling water to loosen and beat until smooth.
Fill a piping bag with a star nozzle and pipe onto cupcakes or smear in the middle and over the top of a 20cm cake using a palette knife.
